Online insurance: policies, payment, claims

Customers buy compulsory motor insurance or another policy online in minutes and file claims with photos from the app. An MVP in 10–16 weeks, from UZS 300 mln; the full version in 24–40 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Online purchase of one product with price calculation
  • MyID or OneID
  • Payment
  • Electronic policy delivery
  • Integration with the policy registry required for that product
What the full version adds
  • Several products
  • Claims with photos and status tracking
  • Partner channels (banks, car dealers)
  • Renewals and reminders
  • Antifraud checks
  • Reports

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today and sample documents
  • Existing data: Excel or an old system
  • Staff to try the system
  • One person who makes the decisions

Questions

What does “Online insurance: policies, payment, claims” cost?
The MVP costs $25,000–50,000 (UZS 300–605 mln), the full version $60,000–150,000 (UZS 720–1,805 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Online insurance: policies, payment, claims” take?
The MVP takes 10–16 weeks, the full version 24–40 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
How the work runs today and sample documents; Existing data: Excel or an old system; Staff to try the system; One person who makes the decisions.
